warnings: Module-level sys.exit(1) on ImportError will terminate the entire host process if this module is imported by other scripts or services.

Callback methods (_on_rigid_body, _on_model_definitions, _on_new_frame) lack try/except blocks. An unhandled exception in these callbacks could crash the NatNet SDK's background threads and silently halt data streaming.
If client.run() returns False in connect(), the local 'client' instance is abandoned without explicit cleanup, potentially leaking SDK-managed threads or sockets depending on implementation.
recommendations: Replace sys.exit(1) with a custom ImportError or RuntimeError to allow graceful handling by calling code.
Wrap all callback bodies in try/except blocks and log errors instead of allowing thread crashes.
Add cleanup logic (e.g., client.shutdown() or explicit deletion) in the connect() failure path to prevent resource leaks.
Parameterize network addresses via configuration files or environment variables rather than hardcoding '127.0.0.1' for production deployment flexibility.
